author: DemirNyks
quote: It's an overrated game; many people love it because they played it as kids. It's a good game, but it's greatly exaggerated.

author: DemirNyks
quote: IT'S ONE OF THE BEST GAMES EVER MADE, AND THE BEST REMAKE. THE GUN SOUNDS AND ANIMATION ARE AMAZING.

author: DemirNyks

game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time

author: DemirNyks
quote: They’ve gone overboard with woke stuff—everything’s terrible except the graphics. I really love Rockstar, but this game is an absolute disaster.

author: DemirNyks
quote: The game was really good. I liked it even more because it was inspired by *Half-Life*, but when I go to the Steam interface in other games, the game pauses while I'm doing this

author: DemirNyks
quote: In my opinion, this is the best RPG game—the graphics are truly amazing, and with each update, the game gets better every day.

author: DemirNyks
quote: The game is short, but I really like its high-quality story and design. I wish Valve had made the game longer.

author: DemirNyks
quote: I really don't know why other people don't like this game—I think it's a pretty good game.

author: DemirNyks
quote: I was really happy that this game has Turkish language support. I bought this game on a whim—I don’t usually play walking games—but I ended up liking it, the story and all.

author: DemirNyks
quote: This game is really a disaster—someone is swearing, someone else is bullying, and that crappy anti-cheat system called Vanguard is monitoring our entire computer.

author: DemirNyks
quote: I played this game in NON-VR mode—the puzzles and graphics were really amazing. I'll play it in VR as soon as possible.

author: DemirNyks
quote: Rockstar games are always high-quality and very detailed; the story in this game was really good.

author: DemirNyks
quote: In my opinion, this is the game with the best story. Everything was put together with great care. Normally, if someone told me there was a game where you use a portal gun to solve puzzles, I wouldn’t play it, but this game turned out to be truly amazing.

author: DemirNyks
quote: This Game Achieved the Impossible in Terms of Its Physics Engine and Graphics; Its Physics Engine Can Compete with Today's Games

author: DemirNyks
quote: This game's story is such a masterpiece—it's written in such incredible detail that we don't even care about the graphics. This game is the forerunner of all FPS games.
